name: Summon Venomous Swarm
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level druid/shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a square of green cloth)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect swarm of venomous snakes
Duration concentration + 2 rounds
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This deadly spell summons a swarm of poisonous snakes. The swarm is under your mental command as long as you concentrate, and it deals 1d6 hp damage plus 1d6 hp poison for every four caster levels you have (see the venomous snake swarm). Otherwise, treat this as a standard summon swarm spell, and use the rules for the swarm subtype.
